name: Cradle
author: Erin Carter
description: Anchored string art: a ring of bright cradle-point anchors sits right on the screen edges, and from each anchor a fan of chords is strung to its neighbours k steps away. The overlapping chord families trace smooth glowing envelope curves - the cardioid, nephroid and rose shapes of classic string art - with glint beads sliding the strings and the anchor nodes burning brightest. The whole figure breathes and slowly re-strings itself.

params.label: Anchors
params.effect: Number of cradle-point anchors around the ring - few gives a stark angular star, many a finely sampled envelope that reads as smooth curves.

params.label: Lines / anchor
params.effect: How many chords fan out from each anchor (to neighbours 1..k steps away); each step adds another nested envelope family, so more lines build a denser layered web.

params.label: Morph speed
params.effect: Rate the anchor ring breathes and rotates; 0 freezes a single crisp figure, higher slowly swings the whole envelope as the anchors glide.

params.label: Line weight
params.effect: Core thickness of each chord in CSS px, with halo scaling alongside - thin reads as hairline wire, thick as soft neon string.

params.label: Glint speed
params.effect: Travel speed of the bright beads sliding along the chords; at 0 they rest as fixed highlights, at max light visibly courses down every string.

params.label: Scatter
params.effect: Randomizes the anchor spacing so the figure is no longer a perfectly symmetric star pinned to the centre; 0 is even and centred, 1 throws the anchors into a lopsided, off-centre web.

params.label: Line tint
params.effect: Colour of the chords: 0 strings them in plain white, 1 takes full palette hues per chord family so the envelopes read in rich colour instead of washing out white.

params.label: Depth levels
params.effect: How many nested string-art webs are stacked into the frame. 1 is the flat single figure; higher adds receding levels that sit progressively inset and dimmer for a layered depth read.

params.label: Depth spacing
params.effect: How far each deeper level shrinks toward the centre. 0 stacks them flat on top of each other; high pushes the back levels far inward so the layers separate into distinct planes of depth.

params.label: Depth fade
params.effect: How much dimmer each deeper level gets. 0 keeps every level equally bright (busy); high fades the back layers into shadow so the front figure reads clearly in front of them.

params.label: Layer twist
params.effect: Rotates each deeper level a little further around the ring, so the layers fan apart instead of sitting concentric. Breaks the rotational symmetry and gives a parallax spin between planes; 0 stacks them aligned.

params.label: Perspective skew
params.effect: Shears the whole figure off its centred axis - the top widens or narrows like a tilted plane - to break the left-right symmetry and add a vanishing-point lean. 0 is the upright symmetric figure.

params.label: Layer variation
params.effect: Re-lays the anchor jitter independently per level so the stacked webs are distinct figures rather than scaled copies. 0 makes every layer the same shape; high throws each level its own asymmetric arrangement.

params.label: Anchor reach
params.effect: How far the anchor ring sits from centre. 1 pins the nodes on the screen edges (the classic read); above 1 pushes them off-screen so chords stream in from beyond the frame with the bright nodes out of view; below 1 pulls the whole figure inward.

params.label: Mouse tilt
params.effect: How strongly the pointer tilts the figure. 0 ignores the mouse; higher lets you lean the whole string-art plane left-right and fore-back by moving the cursor, on top of the fixed Perspective skew. Neutral when the pointer is centred or off the canvas.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Strength of the soft halo, glints and white anchor dots. 1 is the full neon bloom; lower keeps the crisp coloured line cores but cuts the white blow-out where many chords pile up, so the figure reads as fine coloured wire instead of glare.
